title: Social wears the Sefaria Labs brand — a visual preview

tasks.title: Social in the Labs Daylight brand — palette, mark, a colour per learner, questions, small delights

acs.text: WHEN social renders under the reader's light or sepia theme THE SYSTEM SHALL paint its frame in the Daylight palette (page #FFFFFF, white paper after the first review, ink #1B2233, brand #1E3F73, highlight #F6E7B8), and under the dark theme in Night (page #0B1426, ink #F2EDE3, brand #8FB0E8), by re-mapping the reader's `--sefaria-*` tokens inside social's root only; the reader's own page is unchanged, every text colour SHALL keep at least 4.5:1 contrast on its page in both palettes, and page headings SHALL be set in the serif text face
scenarios: AC-001 the frame takes Daylight or Night from the reader's theme

acs.text: WHEN the frame renders THE SYSTEM SHALL show the Sefaria Social mark (a page with two cursors, teal and gold; decorative, hidden from assistive technology) beside the nav and the words "from Sefaria Labs" in the interface language (Hebrew with `lang` and `dir`)
scenarios: AC-002 the frame carries the Social mark and the Labs byline

acs.text: THE SYSTEM SHALL speak in three type voices: what the system says (nav and tabs, section labels, refs, times, counts, status labels such as LIVE, buttons) in the Labs mono, in capitals with tracking; what people wrote (posts, room names, names, the composer) in the serif text face; the interface sans only for small helper text
scenarios: AC-003 the system speaks in mono, people in the serif

acs.text: THE SYSTEM SHALL use the Labs teal only for what is live now (a live card's dot, LIVE label and cursor bar at its reading-start edge), the gold for warmth and action (highlights, the unread count, the active tab, a given Yasher koach, and the primary button, a gold pill), and the violet only for what a model wrote; apart from the mark's two cursors, teal and violet appear nowhere else. A room that is not live is drawn quietly (no fill, muted name)
scenarios: AC-004 teal means live, gold means warmth, violet means AI

acs.text: WHEN an avatar is drawn THE SYSTEM SHALL draw it as presence: white with a ring in the person's cursor colour and the initials in ink, the colour taken from the Labs cursor set (gold, blue, sky, coral, moss, rose; never teal or violet, which are signals), the same colour for the same person every time, each ring at 3:1 or more on white and the initials at 4.5:1 or more
scenarios: AC-005 every learner wears a cursor colour

acs.text: WHEN a post's text ends with a question mark THE SYSTEM SHALL mark it with a "Question" label (Hebrew "שאלה") beside the time, so questions stand out in the feed
WHEN a live dot is shown THE SYSTEM SHALL pulse it slowly, and WHEN a learner gives Yasher koach the icon SHALL turn gold with a short pop; with reduced motion asked for, nothing moves
scenarios: AC-007 small moments of delight, and none with reduced motion
